segments.sn35.146:1.1: “Navapurāṇāni, bhikkhave, kammāni desessāmi kammanirodhaṃ kammanirodhagāminiñca paṭipadaṃ.
segments.sn35.146:1.2: Taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha; bhāsissāmīti.
segments.sn35.146:1.4: Cakkhu, bhikkhave, purāṇakammaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ vedaniyaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ … pe … jivhā purāṇakammā abhisaṅkhatā abhisañcetayitā vedaniyā daṭṭhabbā … pe … mano purāṇakammo abhisaṅkhato abhisañcetayito vedaniyo daṭṭhabbo.
segments.sn35.146:1.9: Yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, etarahi kammaṃ karoti kāyena vācāya manasā, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, navakammaṃ.
segments.sn35.146:1.12: Yo kho, bhikkhave, kāyakammavacīkammamanokammassa nirodhā vimuttiṃ phusati, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, kammanirodho.
segments.sn35.146:1.15: Ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi, sammāsaṅkappo, sammāvācā, sammākammanto, sammāājīvo, sammāvāyāmo, sammāsati, sammāsamādhi – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, kammanirodhagāminī paṭipadā.
segments.sn35.146:1.18: Iti kho, bhikkhave, desitaṃ mayā purāṇakammaṃ, desitaṃ navakammaṃ, desito kammanirodho, desitā kammanirodhagāminī paṭipadā.
segments.sn35.146:1.19: Yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.
segments.sn35.146:1.20: Etāni, bhikkhave, rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññāgārāni. Jhāyatha, bhikkhave, mā pamādattha; mā pacchāvippaṭisārino ahuvattha. Ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī”ti.

lines: Navapurāṇavaggassa paṭhame navapurāṇānīti navāni ca purāṇāni ca.
Cakkhu, bhikkhave, purāṇakammanti na cakkhu purāṇaṃ, kammameva purāṇaṃ, kammato pana nibbattattā paccayanāmena evaṃ vuttaṃ.
Nirodhā vimuttiṃ phusatīti imassa tividhassa kammassa nirodhena vimuttiṃ phusati.
Ayaṃ vuccatīti ayaṃ tassā vimuttiyā ārammaṇabhūto nirodho kammanirodhoti vuccati.
Sampati vijjamānassa cakkhussa taṃnibbattassa kammassa ca adhippetattā “na cakkhu purāṇaṃ, kammameva purāṇan”ti vatvā yathā tassa cakkhussa purāṇapariyāyo vutto, taṃ dassento āha –
Paccayehi abhisamāgantvā katanti taṇhāvijjādipaccayehi abhimukhabhāvena samāgantvā samecca nibbattitaṃ.
Vedanāyāti attānaṃ nissāya ārammaṇaṃ katvā pavattāya vedanāya.
Ārammaṇabhūto nirodho nibbānaṃ “kammanirodho”ti vuccati,“kammaṃ nirujjhati etthā”ti katvā.
“Jhāyatha, bhikkhave, mā pamādatthā”ti vuttattā “pubbabhāgavipassanā kathitā”ti vuttaṃ.
